about.title: About

blocking.description: The story cannot go on until a person answers.
blocking.title: Blocking

kind.description: gap: the spec does not say; conflict: two parts disagree; question: for the owner; note: learned.
kind.title: Kind

refers_to.description: Up to 10 pull requests, commits, files or URLs.
refers_to.title: Refers To

story_id.description: The story the finding came from.
story_id.title: Story Id

text.description: What you found, in 1 to 2000 characters; no secrets.
text.title: Text

AddFindingBody.title: AddFindingBody

AreaRef.description: A work area as a task list names it.
AreaRef.title: AreaRef

BatchSourceOut.description: Answer of batch start (201) and end (200).
BatchSourceOut.title: BatchSourceOut

BriefContract.description: A completed direct prerequisite: what the task builds on.
BriefContract.title: BriefContract

BriefNode.description: An implemented spec node with its evidence.
BriefNode.title: BriefNode

BriefPlacement.description: How an implemented node was placed in the area, with the edges the placement followed.
BriefPlacement.title: BriefPlacement

BriefTask.description: A task of the story with its ``done_when`` items (source ``spec`` binding, ``planner`` the planner's reading).
BriefTask.title: BriefTask

ChapterRef.description: The source document and chapter of a spec node.
ChapterRef.title: ChapterRef

CheckOut.description: One dependency check of ``GET /readyz``; ``detail`` is a fixed code, never exception text.
CheckOut.title: CheckOut

ClaimStoryBody.description: The JSON body of ``POST /story-claim``: the arguments besides the project.

agent_label.description: 1 to 80 printable characters naming your agent, such as Claude Code and the machine; shown to people next to the holder.
agent_label.title: Agent Label

branch.description: 1 to 200 printable characters: the branch the work is on; shown to people.
branch.title: Branch

story_id.description: The story_id of a story from list_stories.
story_id.title: Story Id

ClaimStoryBody.title: ClaimStoryBody

CloseFindingBody.description: Resolve or dismiss: an optional note of at most 500 characters.
CloseFindingBody.title: CloseFindingBody

ClosedFindingOut.description:
The closed finding and the number of tasks that went back to ``pending`` (none: nothing was blocked, or a plan
run had already reset the tasks).
ClosedFindingOut.title: ClosedFindingOut

done.description: The task ids the merge finished; leave it out for every task of the claim.
done.title: Done

merge_commit.description: The merge commit: the full 40 or 64 character hexadecimal hash.
merge_commit.title: Merge Commit

pr_url.description: The merged pull request, an http or https URL.
pr_url.title: Pr Url

DriveLinkRequest.description: The pasted link; checked by the server (an unusable one is ``invalid_link``, not 422).
DriveLinkRequest.title: DriveLinkRequest

EdgeItem.description:
One domain edge of the node: ``direction`` ``out`` leaves it, ``in`` arrives; ``spec_id``, ``label`` and
``name`` are the other end.
EdgeItem.title: EdgeItem

EvidenceOther.description: Another node built from the same lines.
EvidenceOther.title: EvidenceOther

EvidenceSource.description: One evidence fragment: its document and lines, the quote with its context lines, the other nodes there.
EvidenceSource.title: EvidenceSource

ExpansionHit.description: A node to read next: its score, how it was found and its statement or quote with its estimated tokens.
ExpansionHit.title: ExpansionHit

FeatureRef.description: A feature node by its id and name.
FeatureRef.title: FeatureRef

FindingItem.description: An open finding about a node or a story.
FindingItem.title: FindingItem

FindingsOut.description: One page, blocking first, then newest first; ``next`` is the opaque ``after`` of the next page.
FindingsOut.title: FindingsOut

GraphBuildRequest.description: Optional body of ``POST /graph_build``; the level is only validated and logged.
GraphBuildRequest.title: GraphBuildRequest

GraphBuildStatus.description:
``/graph_build``: ids, counts and codes only, never document text.

``settled``, ``spec_changes`` (count per kind) and ``verification_ok`` come
with a finished build; ``error_code`` with a failed one.
GraphBuildStatus.title: GraphBuildStatus

Holder.description: The person behind a claim, a task or a finding: no user id, token or email (tools.md "Holders").
Holder.title: Holder

NodeEdges.description: At most ``edge_limit`` edges (stated first); ``by_relation`` counts all of them, so a hub is summarised.
NodeEdges.title: NodeEdges

NodePaths.description:
At most 3 shortest chains; ``direction`` ``based_on`` (``from`` depends on ``to``), ``affects`` (the reverse)
or null (no chain).
NodePaths.title: NodePaths

PathStepItem.description: One step of a chain: the node it reaches and the edge it takes.
PathStepItem.title: PathStepItem

PlanContent.description:
``/plan/tasks``: the persisted plan; tasks in phase order, then by area, story and id. ``quality`` and
``review`` come from the run that last wrote the plan (none when its result is gone).
PlanContent.title: PlanContent

PlanNotBuildableOut.description:
A member of an area the planner returned as no code work: its id, name (none when the node is gone),
reason code and note.
PlanNotBuildableOut.title: PlanNotBuildableOut

PlanPreview.description:
``/plan/preview``: what a plan run would start from, before it runs.

``features`` are the spec nodes that anchor feature stories; ``calls`` and ``input_tokens`` are the
estimate of the run (none without a finished graph build or when the estimate failed).
PlanPreview.title: PlanPreview

PlanQualityOut.description:
How the run that wrote the plan went.

``fallbacks`` counts planner answers that stayed invalid (or failed) and were replaced by rules, per
planner (``describe``, ``project``, ``tasks``); ``review`` counts review findings by severity;
``unplaced`` counts spec nodes no area anchor reached; ``oversized`` counts tasks over the task size.
PlanQualityOut.title: PlanQualityOut

PlanReviewIssueOut.description: One finding of the run's review: advisory, it changed nothing.
PlanReviewIssueOut.title: PlanReviewIssueOut

PlanSpecRef.description: A spec node a task implements: its id, label and name (none when the node is gone).
PlanSpecRef.title: PlanSpecRef

PlanStartRequest.description: Optional body of ``POST /plan``: ``replan`` re-plans every area from the current graph.
PlanStartRequest.title: PlanStartRequest

PlanStatus.description:
``/plan``: the latest plan run and whether the project has a plan; ids, step names and codes only.

``step`` is the step that runs (or the last one that ran); ``steps_done`` of ``steps_total`` are done.
While a long step runs, ``step_items_done`` of ``step_items_total`` of its items are done (the Tasks step:
planning parts); null otherwise.
PlanStatus.title: PlanStatus

PlanStory.description: A story with its derived progress and task counts by status.
PlanStory.title: PlanStory

PlanTask.description: A task as reads return it (never its claim token), with its waits and revision neighbours.
PlanTask.title: PlanTask

RefersTo.description: A thing outside the spec a finding is about; stored, never fetched. The API checks ``value`` by ``type``.
RefersTo.title: RefersTo

branch.description: The branch that holds the work so far. 1 to 200 printable characters: the branch the work is on; shown to people.
branch.title: Branch

note.description: Why you stop and where the work stands.
note.title: Note

ReleasedClaimOut.description: The tasks a forced release returned to ``pending``; none when the claim was already gone.
ReleasedClaimOut.title: ReleasedClaimOut

note.description: A short note; required for skipped.
note.title: Note

progress.description: done: built and tested on the branch; skipped: not needed, note says why; todo: not done (again).
progress.title: Progress

task_id.description: A task of the story you claimed.
task_id.title: Task Id

ReportedTask.description: A ``list_tasks`` item with the progress just reported (its status stays ``in_progress``).
ReportedTask.title: ReportedTask

SimilarHit.description: A node that reads like the compared node ``like``, with its score and plan state.
SimilarHit.title: SimilarHit

StoryRef.description: A story as a task list names it; the title is None for a story that is not active.
StoryRef.title: StoryRef

StoryRefItem.description: A story named in an answer or an error: a blocker of a preview, an alternative of ``story_claimed``.
StoryRefItem.title: StoryRefItem

StoryTaskItem.description: An open task of a story or unit, as the preview and the claim show it.
StoryTaskItem.title: StoryTaskItem

SummarizeRequest.description: ``model`` is optional and only accepted when it equals the server's ``AGENT_MODEL``.
SummarizeRequest.title: SummarizeRequest

TaskBrief.description: What one coding agent needs for one task, assembled when it is asked for.
TaskBrief.title: TaskBrief

TaskItem.description: One task of a task list: what an agent needs to pick it, with its area, story and readiness.
TaskItem.title: TaskItem

TaskRef.description: A task of a node: its holder while it is in progress, its commit once it is completed.
TaskRef.title: TaskRef

TraceNodeItem.description: A node the trace reached, with the edge from its ``parent`` that reached it first and its plan state.

TraceOwnerItem.description: An owner of a start node, up to the first spine root: the trace's context.

TraceStoryItem.description: A story that holds tasks of the traced nodes.
TraceStoryItem.title: TraceStoryItem

WorkAreaInfo.description: A persisted work area, without derived aggregates.
WorkAreaInfo.title: WorkAreaInfo
